features.featureTitle: Add a public-facing connectivity error state on the storefront homepage that detects when the app cannot reach the deployed backend canister (e.g., fetch/query failures) and shows a clear English message explaining that the site is temporarily unreachable, along with a “Retry” action and the current page URL (window.location.origin + window.location.href) to help the owner share the correct link.

Update the custom domain / publishing documentation to include a troubleshooting section specifically for the browser error “This site can’t be reached”, including a checklist to verify DNS records, platform domain mapping, and a way to confirm a working live URL (both the platform-provided URL and the custom domain URL once configured). Keep all user-facing text in English.
